definitions.gloss: deportment; bearing; manners; the way one carries oneself
definitions.explanation: One's overall physical bearing and behavior, including posture, gestures, and general conduct. Covers both standing and sitting movements.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}いが{美|うつく}しい。
{社会人|しゃかいじん}としての{立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}いを{身|み}につけたい。
examples.english: I want to develop proper manners as a working adult.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}いには{育|そだ}ちの{良|よ}さがにじみ{出|で}ている。
examples.english: His bearing reveals his good upbringing.

notes:
FORMATION:
{立|た}ち (standing) + {居|い} (sitting/being) + {振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い (conduct, behavior). Literally "standing, sitting, and behaving" — covering all aspects of physical deportment.

USAGE:
A somewhat formal word used when evaluating someone's overall physical presence and manners. Often appears in discussions of etiquette, professional development, or descriptions of elegant people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}いが{美|うつく}しい (graceful deportment)
- {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}いに{気|き}をつける (to mind one's manners)
- {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}いを{身|み}につける (to learn proper deportment)
